name: Mahavira (Vardhamana)
shortBio: 24th Tirthankara of Jainism and elder contemporary of the Buddha, who codified Jain metaphysics, radical non-violence (ahimsa), and the multi-perspectival epistemology of Anekantavada.
centralQuestion: How can one liberate the soul (jiva) through radical non-violence and recognize that ultimate truth is multi-faceted and irreducible to dogmatic absolutes?

keyWorks.title: Acharanga Sutra
keyWorks.description: Oldest canonical Jain scripture detailing the conduct of ascetics, radical ahimsa toward all living beings, and the philosophy of non-attachment.
